$comment: Public production deployments, one Vercel project per entrant (team jack-shelton). runtime/region are what Vercel used. smoke = plain unauthenticated curl; correctness = shared runner against the public URL. Early-phase failures on the real network are framework results unless noted.

markless.buildIdMethod: vercel-<entrant>-<first 8 hex of sha256 over sorted relative path + NUL + bytes + NUL of every file in the app dir, skipping dirs node_modules .output .vercel dist build .svelte-kit .react-router tmp .nitro .vscode and files BENCH.md build-info.json .DS_Store *.tsbuildinfo>

frameworkSourceHash.method: sha256 (first 12 hex) over sorted path + bytes of packages/{core,router,bundler,compiler,web,runtime,serializer,analyzer}/src/** at deploy time; working tree at HEAD d5107ae0 plus uncommitted changes, including the router fix that bundles the nitro import for the endpoint wrapper

markless.build: NITRO_PRESET=vercel pnpm run build (router Nitro vercel preset, working-tree @markless packages), then vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod
markless.protection: Vercel standard: production domain public, per-deployment URLs behind Vercel SSO (302)

correctness.runner: runner/correctness.mjs --target-url <url> --transport direct (Chromium, normal profile, no proxy)

qwik.region: edge (global; served from cle1 for the smoke host)
qwik.buildIdMethod: vercel-<entrant>-<first 8 hex of sha256 over sorted relative path + NUL + bytes + NUL of every file in the app dir, skipping dirs node_modules .output .vercel dist build .svelte-kit .react-router tmp .nitro .vscode and files BENCH.md build-info.json .DS_Store *.tsbuildinfo>
qwik.build: pnpm run build (vercelEdgeAdapter), vercel.json headers mirrored into .vercel/output/config.json, then vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod
qwik.protection: Vercel standard: production domain public, per-deployment URLs behind Vercel SSO (302)

qwik.note: Qwik v2 has only the Vercel Edge adapter. The adapter output config.json drops the vercel.json immutable-cache headers for /build and /assets; they were copied into config.json after the build (what `vercel build` does).
